items.name: 50 Years of Cubing - Vallentuna 2024
items.information:
Välkomna till 50 Years of Cubing - Vallentuna 2024!

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. 

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

-----

Welcome to 50 Years of Cubing - Vallentuna 2024!

Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

[![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.name: SacQuiet Spring 2024

venue.name: Private Residence
venue.details: Details will be disclosed privately to registered competitors

items.information:
![This competition is in partnership with West Coast Cubing, LLC](https://i.imgur.com/jmSpkQE.png)
![Image description](https://b2b989d215c701ad63d7-288404e13f895703cf2798bf6ae95228.ssl.cf1.rackcdn.com/734655566969-350.png)

From the organizers that brought you SacCubing, comes SacQuiet Fall 2023! 
### **This competition will be specializing in quiet events and will not have 3x3 or any traditional events.** If you would like to sign up for a competition involving those events, please check out [SacCubing XVII 2024,](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SacCubingXVII2024/) happening on May 18th, the day before.
### Lunch will be provided
- The registration fee is built in to include an all-expenses paid for competitor lunch, courtesy of Domino's Pizza. If you'd like an alternative lunch, feel free to leave the venue however this portion will not be compensated.
